006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticMetapathException;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IIntegerItem;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IQNameItem;
018import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IItemType;
019import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
020
021import java.util.List;
022
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
024
025/**
026 * /** Implements <a href=
027 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-function-lookup">fn:function-lookup</a>
028 * functions.
029 */
030public final class FnFunctionLookup {
031  @NonNull
032  private static final String NAME = "function-lookup";
033
034  @NonNull
035  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
036      .name(NAME)
037      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
038      .deterministic()
039      .contextIndependent()
040      .focusIndependent()
041      .argument(IArgument.builder()
042          .name("name")
043          .type(IQNameItem.type())
044          .one()
045          .build())
046      .argument(IArgument.builder()
047          .name("arity")
048          .type(IIntegerItem.type())
049          .one()
050          .build())
051      .returnType(IItemType.function())
052      .returnZeroOrOne()
053      .functionHandler(FnFunctionLookup::execute)
054      .build();
055
056  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
057  @NonNull
058  private static ISequence<IFunction> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
059      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
060      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
061      IItem focus) {
062    IQNameItem name = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true)));
063    IIntegerItem arity = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true)));
064    IFunction matchingFunction = null;
065
066    try {
067      matchingFunction = dynamicContext.lookupFunction(
068          name.toEnhancedQName(),
069          arity.toIntValueExact());
070    } catch (StaticMetapathException ex) {
071      if (ex.getErrorCode().getCode() != StaticMetapathException.NO_FUNCTION_MATCH) {
072        // this is something other than a non-match
073        throw ex;
074      }
075    }
076
077    return ISequence.of(matchingFunction);
078  }
079
080  private FnFunctionLookup() {
081    // disable construction
082  }
083}
